The Witness co-op: other people's work in this mod
====================================================

The co-op mod itself is under the MIT licence in LICENSE.txt. It contains the work of other projects, also under the MIT licence.
Their notices follow, as their licences ask. Thank you to everyone named here.


1. The randomizers (the launcher's Randomizers tab)
---------------------------------------------------

The randomizers are built into the mod from the Witness Random Puzzle Generator and its forks, each as its author published it:

- Sigma's Randomizer (Normal and Expert) and the Variety Randomizer: the Witness Random Puzzle Generator as maintained for Archipelago by
  NewSoupVi, https://github.com/NewSoupVi/The-Witness-Randomizer-for-Archipelago (from sigma144's https://github.com/sigma144/witness-randomizer
  and jbzdarkid's https://github.com/jbzdarkid/witness-randomizer, with Penguin12335's Variety)
- Ascension: Penguin12335's Variety Randomizer, https://github.com/Penguin12335/Variety-Randomiser (with symbols from Looksy and from chuukunn's
  Despair Randomizer)
- Despair and its Symbols mode: chuukunn's Despair Randomizer, https://github.com/chuukunn/witness-randomizer
- The Symbol Shuffler, Emptiness and Puzzle Pack: Dawgup's (KemSpeedruns) Symbol Shuffler, https://github.com/KemSpeedruns/witness-randomizer
- The Star Randomizer: Parker's (MrP4rK3r2), https://github.com/MrP4rK3r2/witness-randomizer
- The Tutorializer: hatkirby's, https://code.fourisland.com/witness-tutorializer

Written by sigma144, jbzdarkid, NewSoupVi, Penguin12335, chuukunn, Dawgup, Parker, hatkirby, blastron, Jarno458, ReverM and others.

The mod runs their puzzle generators unchanged apart from how they reach the game: inside the game instead of from a separate program, and a
few small fixes marked "witness-coop" in the source. The authors made them for everyone to use; they did not make or check this co-op version,
so please report problems with it to the co-op mod.

All of them are under this licence:

2. The Witness Trainer's options (the launcher's Randomizers tab)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

The walking speed, field of view, noclip, challenge time limit and environmental-puzzle overlay options are ported from jbzdarkid's
Witness Trainer, https://github.com/jbzdarkid/witness-trainer (the patterns it finds the game's values with, and the values it writes).

3. Which panels open what ("parts of the map done" for a new game)
-------------------------------------------------------------------

The order in which the game needs its panels solved comes from the logic of Archipelago's world for The Witness:
    https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago (worlds/witness)
